data.text: On all fasting visits, study participants are required to report to the site in a fasting condition, after at least 8 hours without eating, drinking (except water), or performing any significant physical activity. Additionally, the participant should not take their study intervention before the fasting visit. If a participant is adversely affected by the fasting condition, they are allowed to eat; however, specific study procedures need to be completed while fasting.

data.name: Minimum age requirement
data.text: Participant must be at least 18 years of age or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the informed consent, whichever is older.

data.name: Type 2 diabetes diagnosis
data.text: Have a clinical diagnosis of T2D based on the World Health Organization classification or other locally applicable diagnostic standards (see Section 10.8).

data.name: HbA1c range at screening
data.text: Have HbA1c ≥7.0% (53 mmol/mol) to ≤9.5% (80 mmol/mol) despite diet and exercise treatment, as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: Insulin and antihyperglycemic medication naivety
data.text: Are naïve to insulin therapy except for gestational diabetes or ≤14 days use for acute treatment and have not used any oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications during the 90 days preceding Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3 (randomization).

data.name: Motivation and ability to follow study procedures
data.text: Are motivated and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and are able to follow study procedures as required, including: store provided study intervention as directed; perform SMBG per protocol; maintain a study eDiary; complete patient questionnaires; and self_inject study intervention. Note: Persons with physical limitations who are not able to perform the injections must have the assistance of an individual trained to inject the intervention.

data.name: Stable weight prior to screening
data.text: Are of stable weight (self_reported change ≤5 kg or 11 pounds) for at least 90 days prior to Visit 1 and agree to not initiate an intensive diet or exercise program during the study with the intent of reducing body weight other than the lifestyle and/or dietary measures for diabetes treatment.

data.name: Minimum BMI requirement
data.text: Have a BMI ≥23.0 kg/m2 at Visit 1.

data.name: Sex and contraceptive/barrier requirements
data.text: Males, WOCBP, or WNOCBP may participate in this trial. Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. For the contraception requirements of this protocol, see Section 10.4. Note: the word "male" is used to describe an individual assigned male at birth (AMAB) and the word "female" is used to describe an individual assigned female at birth (AFAB), for simplicity.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Section 10.1.3, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Type 1 diabetes exclusion
data.text: Have T1D.

data.name: History of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state
data.text: Have a history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state or coma within the last 6 months prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3.

data.name: History of severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
data.text: Have a history of severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness within the last 6 months prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3.

data.name: Current or planned treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema
data.text: Are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of anti_vascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors. Note: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment. In the presence of any degree of diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, further ophthalmologic assessment will follow local standards of care to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity. Exceptions: The following are allowed if they occurred >1 year before screening (Visit 1): liposuction; cryolipolysis; or abdominoplasty.

data.name: Prior or planned endoscopic or device_based therapy for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned endoscopic (for example, mucosal ablation or gastric artery embolization) and/or device_based (for example, lap band, intragastric balloon, or endoluminal duodenal_jejunal bypass liner) therapy for obesity. Exception: Prior device_based therapy is acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1).

data.name: NYHA Class IV congestive heart failure
data.text: Have New York Heart Association Functional Classification IV congestive heart failure.

data.name: Recent cardiovascular conditions
data.text: Have had any of the following CV conditions within 90 days prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3: acute myocardial infarction; cerebrovascular accident (stroke); or hospitalization for congestive heart failure.

data.name: Clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality
data.text: Have a known clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality, for example, severe diabetic gastroparesis or gastric outlet obstruction, or chronically take drugs that directly affect GI motility.

data.name: Hepatic conditions or abnormal liver laboratory values
data.text: Have acute or chronic hepatitis, including a history of autoimmune hepatitis, signs or symptoms of any other liver disease other than MASLD, or any of the following as determined by the central laboratory during screening: ALT or AST level >5.0× ULN for the reference range; ALP level ≥1.5× ULN for the reference range; TBL level ≥1.5× ULN for the reference range, except for cases of known Gilbert's syndrome; hepatitis B infection, defined as positive hepatitis B core antibody and positive for HBV DNA, or positive hepatitis B surface antigen; and positive hepatitis C antibody and positive for HCV RNA.

data.name: Severely reduced eGFR
data.text: Have an eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73 m2 as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (calculated by Chronic Kidney Disease_Epidemiology cystatin_c equation).

data.name: Clinically relevant hematological condition interfering with HbA1c
data.text: Have any clinically relevant hematological condition that may interfere with HbA1c measurement, for example, hemolytic anemias or sickle cell disease.

data.text: Visit 3 (randomization) to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1; screening period is up to 4 weeks (18_28 days).

data.name: Glycemic Eligibility Condition
data.description: HbA1c range required at screening
data.text: HbA1c ≥7.0% (53 mmol/mol) to ≤9.5% (80 mmol/mol) as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: Antihyperglycemic Medication Naïve Condition
data.description: Prior medication restriction for eligibility
data.text: Naïve to insulin therapy except for gestational diabetes or ≤14 days use for acute treatment, and no oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications during the 90 days preceding Visit 1 or between Visit 1 and Visit 3 (randomization).

data.name: Age / Consent Condition
data.description: Minimum age at informed consent
data.text: At least 18 years of age or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction, whichever is older, at the time of signing informed consent.

data.name: Informed Consent Prior to Procedures
data.description: Condition required before any study procedures
data.text: The ICF must be signed before any tests or procedures are performed.

data.name: Fasting State Condition
data.description: Fasting requirement for fasting visits
data.text: Participants must report fasting after at least 8 hours without eating, drinking (except water), or significant physical activity, and must not take study intervention before the fasting visit. If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non_fasting state, reschedule the visit within the allowable visit interval.

data.name: Retinopathy Eligibility Confirmation Condition
data.description: Ophthalmologic eligibility based on fundus photography
data.text: Eligibility (exclusion criterion 13) MUST be confirmed based on fundus photographs and any additional ophthalmological evaluation needed at screening.

data.name: Baseline Retinopathy/DME Condition for Week 24 Imaging
data.description: Conditional performance of follow_up fundus photography
data.text: Follow_up fundus photography and additional ophthalmological evaluation are performed at Week 24 (±4 weeks) only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline; all participants repeat imaging at Week 40 (_4 weeks to +2 weeks).

data.name: Hepatic Interruption/Discontinuation Laboratory Criteria
data.description: Laboratory thresholds for study drug interruption or discontinuation
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5.

data.name: Close Hepatic Monitoring Stabilization Condition
data.description: Condition allowing reduced monitoring frequency
data.text: Subsequently, the frequency of monitoring may be lowered to once every 1 to 2 weeks, if the participant's clinical condition and lab results stabilize.

data.name: Pregnancy Condition
data.description: Occurrence of pregnancy during the study
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Low BMI / Excessive Weight Reduction Condition
data.description: Trigger for dose modification and weight monitoring
data.text: BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction; monitor weight after dose reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2.

data.name: Poor Nutrition or Dehydration Condition
data.description: Trigger for management, dose modification, or discontinuation
data.text: Participants with or at risk of poor nutrition or dehydration may undergo dose modification or discontinuation per Section 6.6.2 and Appendix 11.

data.name: Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia Condition
data.description: Condition triggering rescue therapy
data.text: Rescue therapy for severe persistent hyperglycemia may be initiated per Section 6.9.4.

data.name: WOCBP Pregnancy Test Condition
data.description: Pregnancy testing conditions
data.text: Urine pregnancy test result must be available before the first dose of study intervention for WOCBP. Perform additional pregnancy tests if a menstrual period is missed, if there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.

data.name: Unscheduled Immunogenicity Sampling Condition
data.description: Condition requiring additional immunogenicity samples
data.text: Collect additional unscheduled samples if systemic drug hypersensitivity reactions (immediate or nonimmediate) or injection site reactions occur (severe or recurrent).

data.name: Contraceptive Use Restriction Condition
data.description: Restriction on injectable/implantable contraceptives
data.text: Use of subcutaneous/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives is prohibited except when initiated and used continuously for at least 18 months prior to study entry.

data.name: Safety Follow_up Visit Waiver Condition
data.description: Condition under which the safety follow_up visit is not required
data.text: Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow_up visit if they have been off study intervention for at least 28 days.

data.name: Exceptional Circumstances Condition
data.description: Alternative conduct of the SoA
data.text: For participants whose participation is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, refer to Section 10.14 for additional guidance.

data.name: Multi_Day Visit Condition
data.description: Condition allowing visit procedures across multiple days
data.text: Visit procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day if all activities are completed within the allowed visit tolerance period of each visit.

data.name: Pre_Dose Assessment Completion Condition
data.description: Sequence condition at randomization visit
data.text: All assessments should be completed before the administration of the first dose of study intervention; immunogenicity and PK samples for immunogenicity are collected before dosing; triplicate ECGs collected before all blood samples; vital signs taken before ECG tracing; AEs collected before PHQ_9 and C_SSRS.

data.name: DID_EQ Conditional Administration
data.description: Condition for administering DID_EQ at early discontinuation
data.text: DID_EQ is collected at the ED visit if discontinuation is at or before Week 4.

data.name: Concomitant Medication Review Condition
data.description: Ongoing assessment of background medications
data.text: Monitor closely and routinely assess the need to adjust or discontinue antihypertensive medications, diuretics, lipid_lowering agents, laxatives, and anti_emetics.

data.name: Screening
data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed; screening laboratory results are reviewed at Visit 2 to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Screening to Treatment Period Transition (Randomizatio
data.text: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria prior to randomization and administration of the first dose of study intervention at Visit 3; Visit 3 must occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1 (18_28 days). Randomization is performed via IWRS in a 1:1:1:1 ratio to retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, 12 mg, or placebo.

data.name: Treatment Period to Safety Follow_up Transition
data.text: A posttreatment safety follow_up visit (Visit 801) will occur approximately 4 weeks (±5 days) following the last treatment period visit (Visit 11, Week 40).

data.name: Hepatic Discontinuation/Interruption Rule
data.text: Study intervention is interrupted or discontinued if ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5 (Sections 7.1.2 and 8.2.6.3).

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation from Study Intervention
data.text: Permanent discontinuation from study intervention per Section 7.1.1, including a discontinuation criterion for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration.

data.name: Temporary Interruption of Study Intervention
data.text: Temporary interruption of study intervention for gastrointestinal tolerability or for reasons unrelated to gastrointestinal tolerability (Sections 6.6.4 and 7.1.3).

data.name: Dose Modification via Blinded IWRS
data.text: All dose adjustments are managed in a blinded fashion through IWRS (Section 6.6).

data.name: Dose Reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or Excessive Weight Reduction
data.text: Dose reduction with subsequent weight monitoring is recommended for participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction (Section 6.6.3).

data.name: Dose Modification for Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.text: Dose modification is an option for participants with or at risk of poor nutrition or dehydration (Sections 6.6 and 6.6.2; Appendix 11).

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Rescue therapy/rescue medication may be initiated for severe persistent hyperglycemia (Sections 6.9.4 and 6.9.5); initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medication is an intercurrent event for the efficacy estimand and, where possible, fundus photography at Week 40 should be performed prior to the start of new antihyperglycemic medication.

data.name: Pregnancy_Related Discontinuation and Withdrawal
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study (Section 8.3.2).

data.name: Early Discontinuation (ED) Visit Transition
data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in the treatment period, perform the activities listed for ED in the SoA.

data.name: Symptomatic Medication for Gastrointestinal Symptoms
data.text: Symptomatic medication may be given for gastrointestinal symptoms (Section 6.9.6).

data.name: Continued Access after End of Study
data.text: Continued access to study intervention after the end of the study per Section 6.7.

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from the Study
data.description: Participant may discontinue/withdraw from the study at any time (Section 7.2); ED visit procedures are performed if discontinuation occurs before the last treatment period visit.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.description: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention (Section 7.1.1), including hepatic criteria (ALT/AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L with TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5) and poor nutrition/dehydration criterion; participants may remain in the study for follow_up.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up
data.description: Participant lost to follow_up per Section 7.3.

data.name: Pregnancy Withdrawal
data.description: Female participants who become pregnant discontinue study intervention and are withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of the 40_week treatment period (through Visit 11, Week 40) and the 4_week safety follow_up period (Visit 801, approximately 4 weeks after the last treatment period visit), including eDiary return.

data.name: Safety Follow_up Waiver Exit
data.description: Participants who discontinued study intervention early and attend only Visit 11 (Week 40) exit without a safety follow_up visit if they have been off study intervention for at least 28 days.

data.name: Visit 1 Screening Eligibility Decision
data.description: Assessment of inclusion/exclusion criteria, central laboratory HbA1c, hepatitis screening, and fundus photography at Visit 1.

data.name: Visit 2 Laboratory Eligibility Confirmation Decision
data.description: Review of screening laboratory results and ophthalmological findings to confirm eligibility; Visit 2 may occur as soon as Visit 1 criteria are confirmed.

data.name: Visit 3 Randomization Decision
data.description: Confirm inclusion/exclusion criteria, confirm no antihyperglycemic medication use between Visit 1 and Visit 3, confirm negative pregnancy test for WOCBP, then randomize via IWRS (no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1) and administer first dose.

data.name: Week 4 Early Discontinuation PRO Decision
data.description: DID_EQ administered at ED visit only if discontinuation occurs at or before Week 4.

data.name: PK Sampling Window Assignment Decision (Weeks 7, 15, 19)
data.description: IWRS assigns each participant one PK sampling window (1_24 hr, 24_96 hr, or 120_168 hr post dose) at the PK_only visits at Weeks 7, 15, and 19.

data.name: Week 24 Retinopathy Follow_up Imaging Decision
data.description: Perform follow_up fundus photography at Week 24 (±4 weeks) only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline.

data.name: Hepatic Monitoring and Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate close hepatic monitoring, reduce monitoring frequency to every 1_2 weeks upon stabilization, or interrupt/discontinue study intervention based on hepatic laboratory criteria.

data.name: Nutrition/Hydration and Low BMI Management Decision
data.description: Decision at each visit regarding dose modification, weight monitoring, or discontinuation for participants with poor nutrition, dehydration, BMI ≤20 kg/m2, or excessive weight reduction.

data.name: Glycemic Rescue Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate rescue therapy for severe persistent hyperglycemia; fundus photography at Week 40 preferably performed prior to start of new antihyperglycemic medication.

data.name: Concomitant Medication Intensity Evaluation Decision
data.description: Evaluation of antihypertensive and lipid_lowering medication treatment intensity changes from randomization at Weeks 12, 32, 40, and ED.

data.name: Safety Follow_up Requirement Decision
data.description: Determine whether Visit 801 safety follow_up is required based on whether the participant has been off study intervention for at least 28 days.
